call_points.text: **MICE & ARR trends:** Outlook for MICE segment demand remains positive with expectation of ARR trends continuing in coming quarters.
**West Asia geopolitical impact:** Q4 revenue was marginally impacted by West Asia crisis cancellations, mitigated by domestic demand.
**One-time labor provision:** Standalone FY26 EBITDA was impacted by a ₹4.22 Cr provision towards gratuity under the new Labour Code.
**Net debt-free:** Company turned net debt-free on a consolidated basis as of 31 March 2026.
**Renovations completed:** Incurred ₹8.01 Cr on hotel renovations across Taj Deccan, Chandigarh, and Club House in FY26.
**Subsidiary dividend:** Green Woods Palaces recommended a 60% dividend (₹6 per share), adding to parent cash flows.
**Inorganic expansion:** Actively exploring inorganic growth opportunities to get faster market access while maintaining return thresholds.
